110080101.text: Ah, children, come, come! Haha, you've arrived at just the right moment. I've been looking for you.

110080102.text: Oh, what is it, Granny? Need any help?

110080103.text: Oh, no, no. You've done so much for Liyue Harbor already. I could hardly ask for more.

110080104.text: In fact, my old friends and I have been putting our heads together to think of what sort of gift we might give you in return.

110080108.text: Haha, oh, child. You are so very modest — uncommonly so, even. But you mustn't decline this gift, I simply won't allow it.

110080109.text: When you traversed my old teapot in search of the Cleansing Bell, I heard your little friend mention that you often camp out in the wilds...

110080110.text: That simply won't do — especially since, I imagine, you still have a very long journey ahead of you.

110080111.text: Fortunately, I have not yet grown so old as to see my Sub-Space Creation abilities atrophy...

110080113.text: Oh? Did my friends never mention that to you? Well then. It is a blessing we old folks once received from Rex Lapis — part of our "illumination," if you will.

110080114.text: I will not go into too much detail, but Sub-Space Creation is the ability to create a small, autonomous pocket world.

110080115.text: The teapot that you entered previously was a little trinket created using that ability.

110080117.text: So, in the eyes of an adeptus, creating a magic teapot world is just child's play, huh?

110080118.text: Indeed, the teapot is nothing to boast of. One such as myself must depart from this realm to create a world of one's own. Rex Lapis, on the other hand, moved mountains and seas... That is what one might call an exercise of true power.

110080119.text: But that's enough nostalgia for now. The gift that I have prepared for you just requires a few final materials to add the finishing touch...

110080201.text: Hello there, Mr. Krosl. How's business been?

110080202.text: Oh, good, very good. All thanks to your advice, Miss Yanfei. What brings you here today?

110080203.text: You're too kind, I was simply doing my job. Now, I believe that the last time we met, you mentioned that you were looking to source some Smaragdus Jadeite to make hairpins. Have there been any further developments on this front?

110080204.text: Oh, I... uh... Well, yes, as a matter of fact, in the end, I did acquire a small piece of Smaragdus Jadeite and had it fashioned into a pair of hairpins.

110080205.text: Miss Yanfei... might I presume that you have an interest in the hairpins? I must apologize, I have already rented them out to a lady named <color=#00E1FFFF>Zhiqiao</color>... If you'd like to inspect them, you may have to wait quite some time.

110080206.text: Wait, isn't Smaragdus Jadeite really rare? Aren't you worried about the hairpins getting damaged or lost while they're being rented out?

110080207.text: No, I'm not worried in the slightest, because I signed a contract with Ms. Zhiqiao before renting them to her.

110080208.text: The contract makes it quite clear that if she loses or damages the item in question, she must compensate me for its full original value.

110080209.text: In return, I included a clause that guarantees the Smaragdus Jadeite is genuine, with a penalty of ten times the item's value payable by me to Ms. Zhiqiao in the event that it is shown to be a fake.

110080211.text: Guaranteed genuine, with ten times the value payable if this claim is shown to be false... Yes, these terms are very clear indeed.

110080212.text: Of course. This way, both the client and I have the assurance we need. To ensure fairness, each of us has retained an original copy of the contract.

110080213.text: In that case, might you know where Ms. Zhiqiao lives? We'd like to pay her a visit and have a look at the hairpins.

110080214.text: Oh, of course. She wrote her address down when we signed our contract. Here, I'll mark it on your map for you.

110080215.text: Thanks a lot, Mr. Krosl. We'll be off now.

110080403.text: Y—Yes, that's me. Is there something I can help you with?

110080404.text: How do you do, Ms. Zhiqiao? We understand from Mr. Krosl that you recently rented a pair of hairpins from him.

110080405.text: My associates and I are very interested in them. Would you mind letting us take a look at them?

110080406.text: The hairpins... I can't lend them to you right now... I—I've lost them.

110080407.text: I don't know how it could have happened. I always kept them right by my side, and I hadn't even worn them yet...

110080408.text: I spent so much money on them... If I have to pay their original value... Th—There's no way I could come up with that amount of money on such short notice.

110080409.text: Why did you need them in the first place?

110080410.text: I... My family is in the ore business, too. But business has been suffering ever since The Chasm was sealed off.

110080411.text: We now have a backlog of paid-up orders just sitting around, so we've been having to purchase some stock from other ore merchants to complete them.

110080412.text: A big banquet is coming up in a few days, and several ore merchants I know of will be there. I need this opportunity to mingle and discuss prices.

110080413.text: That's what the hairpins were for, to... Well, to keep up appearances. I can't have them looking down on me.

110080414.text: But now that I've lost the hairpins... What will I do...

110080415.text: Huh... why does Paimon have a sudden strong sense of déjà vu...

110080416.text: Maybe because this is the part where we say, "we can help"?

110080417.text: W—Would you really? I sent a commission to the Adventurers' Guild, but I haven't heard anything back from them yet.

110080418.text: Hold on, don't run off looking for the hairpins just yet. Ms. Zhiqiao, would you let me have a look at the rental contract you signed?

110080419.text: Huh? Well, I mean, sure, I have it right here. Here you are.

110080421.text: That's right, Yanfei said she's a legal adviser, didn't she? Maybe she can help Zhiqiao somehow?

110080422.text: That would be a little unfair to Krosl.

110080423.text: True... Though, surely there must be a win-win solution?

110080424.text: Right, I've finished reading the contract. The terms are very clear, and they do indeed stipulate that you must pay Mr. Krosl the original value of the hairpins as compensation for the loss.

110080425.text: Furthermore, the contract also expressly states that the amount of compensation must take current market prices into account...

110080426.text: And given the rarity of Smaragdus Jadeite, I fear that the final amount of compensation may end up being significantly higher as a result...

110080428.text: Uh-oh, Zhiqiao looks like she's about to faint...

110080429.text: ...However, all of this is assuming that it is indeed genuine Smaragdus Jadeite that was inlaid into the hairpins.

110080430.text: Did you really have to pause before saying that part? ...Anyway, the hairpins are lost, so how exactly would we be able to find out if the jadeite is genuine or not?

110080431.text: Whichever way you look at it, we've gotta start by finding those hairpins.

110080432.text: Except that if we found the hairpins, there'd no longer be any need to check whether the jadeite is genuine, would there?

110080434.text: Please... Please, I... Don't trouble yourselves over this. The fact is, I lost the item and I should pay compensation per the contract...

110080435.text: It's such a huge sum of money, though...

110080436.text: However much it is, I will have to pay it... My family are merchants, after all. It's vital that we keep our word and respect our contracts.

110080437.text: Now that it's come to this, I really shouldn't keep Krosl in the dark any longer. I'll go and inform him of the issue, and then... negotiate the amount of compensation.

110080438.text: Mm, yes, legally speaking, it seems this is the most sensible course of action. But before that, I have some questions about the hairpins.

110080439.text: So hold on a moment, Ms. Zhiqiao. When you first touched the hairpins, what did you feel?

110080440.text: What did I feel? Well, I remember that the gemstones set into the pins were perfectly smooth to the touch, like the finest-quality jade...

110080441.text: My family has seen much jade pass through its hands in the past, so I am quite certain of my judgment in this matter.

110080442.text: Smooth to the touch... finest-quality jade...

110080444.text: No, it's nothing. I just need to re-examine a few things. Let's head over to <color=#00E1FFFF>Mr. Krosl's</color>.

110080501.text: Ah, Miss Yanfei, you've returned... with Ms. Zhiqiao in tow too, I see. How are the hairpins? I trust you're quite satisfied with them?

110080504.text: ...You lost them!? Are you serious? Do you have any idea how expensive they were!?

110080505.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Truly, I am... I'll pay the compensation as per our contract, every last Mora...

110080506.text: Mora? Hmph! Do you have any idea what I had to go through to get my hands on that Smaragdus Jadeite!?

110080507.text: I... I just don't... Hmph, forget it. Talking won't bring them back. Since Miss Yanfei is here, I suppose we can just have her estimate the amount that needs to be paid.

110080508.text: No problem. But before I can give an official estimate, I'll need to do a little market research. Ah, yes, and if I may just confirm again...

110080509.text: It was in fact genuine Smaragdus Jadeite inlaid into the hairpins, correct?

110080510.text: Of course! Genuine article, guaranteed, or I pay back ten times the value!

110080511.text: Alright, understood. I'll conduct some market research, and once I'm back, I'll provide an official assessment of the sum owed by Ms. Zhiqiao in compensation. Please wait here, Mr. Krosl.

110080512.text: Thank you very much. Hmph, how could she lose my hairpins... She'd better pay every last Mora that they're worth!

110080514.text: Looks like I'll have to find some way to raise that money...

110080515.text: Please wait, Ms. Zhiqiao. I have something to discuss with you.

110080516.text: It's not convenient to speak here, so... Let's find somewhere that <color=#00E1FFFF>we can sit</color> and talk in more detail.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a convenient place to talk to Zhiqiao

110081601.text: Paimon can think of someone who would definitely disagree with your reasoning...

110081602.text: I think there is more than just "reason" involved here, Paimon.

110081603.text: Well, since we've got what we came for, it's time to pay <color=#00E1FFFF>Granny</color> a visit. I'll bet she's been on tenterhooks for a while now.

110081201.text: Miss Yanfei, what is this about? Are you... Are you here to tell me how much I owe?

110081202.text: No. What I wanted to talk about is: There is a chance that the ore inlaid on those hairpins may not be Smaragdus Jadeite after all.

110081204.text: Huh? What do you mean? Are you implying that you already sneaked off and found them?

110081205.text: Obviously not. I'm no adventurer, let alone a member of the Guild. I don't run thankless, time-consuming errands for a living. Let's just say... I made some deductions.

110081206.text: I don't know if Granny told you this, but Smaragdus Jadeite is found deep underground and contains very concentrated elemental energy.

110081207.text: If mere mortals come into contact with it, well, they'll be sick in the best case, and in the worst-case, they could even experience a dramatic change of personality. It most certainly would not be "smooth to the touch."

110081208.text: Ms. Zhiqiao, did you, at any time, feel unwell while the hairpins were in your possession?

110081209.text: No, not at all. I felt perfectly fine the whole time, not even the slightest bit unwell. I didn't feel anything special at all, in fact...

110081210.text: Hmm... Now that is strange. I noticed earlier that there were elemental traces in Mr. Krosl's vicinity.

110081211.text: If I have deduced correctly, he may still have the Smaragdus Jadeite in his possession.

110081212.text: If that's the case, we should go confront him right now and expose his dirty scam right to his face!

110081213.text: Absolutely not. If we were to confront him now, there's no way he would admit to it. Eventually, he would find some argument to compel us to leave...

110081214.text: And then he'd throw the Smaragdus Jadeite into the sea the moment we were gone...

110081215.text: After that, he would simply insist that Ms. Zhiqiao pay up, per the contract. He would lose nothing.

110081216.text: Meanwhile, we would have to look under every stone in Liyue, hoping and praying that the hairpins do actually still exist somewhere in this world...

110081218.text: So vivid that Paimon thinks it might be experience talking.

110081219.text: Oh, it certainly is. I've seen my fair share of situations like this, and brute-force methods are certainly one way of resolving them... Fortunately, I have far more elegant solutions at my disposal. I'll share them with you in due course.

110081220.text: W—Well then, since you're so experienced in dealing with problems like this... Perhaps you could help me, Ms. Yanfei?

110081221.text: Oh, that won't be a problem... But first, Ms. Zhiqiao, could I ask you to please sign this contract?

110081222.text: ...Huh? Does there have to be a contract for everything? Paimon can't even keep track.

110081223.text: If I had one Mora for every time I hear the word "contract"...

110081224.text: It feels like Yanfei is even more concerned with them than a certain someone else we know.

110081225.text: These are my formal Terms of Engagement. Everything prior to now has just been pro-bono advice, but for me to investigate any further, I require a written contract.

110081226.text: Any work commissioned but not bound by a contract cannot be relied upon.

110081227.text: I understand. Then I will be glad to place this matter into your capable hands if you will take it, Miss Yanfei.

110081228.text: No problem! Just sign here, and I'll sign too... Okay... Now, write your address here, and then sign on this page as well...

110081229.text: And I'll also need your signatures on pages five, seven, and on the very last page. Finally, if you could just use this ink pad to make a handprint over here...

110081230.text: *sigh* This contract has so many pages... Paimon's all out of brain juice again.

110081232.text: Alright, that should do it. My fees are the same as always, and they're written in the contract. Have a look through and let me know if you have any questions.

110081233.text: I've had a read through. Everything checks out.

110081234.text: Well then, here's your copy of the contract. I will retain the other copy.

110081236.text: Not for now, no. Despite how intractable this problem might sound, it will actually be quite straightforward to resolve — once we've got some things squared away.

110081237.text: I don't believe you've been part of an investigation like this before — in which case, hopefully, this should be quite the experience.

110081238.text: Miss Yanfei, I have to ask... Why are you helping me?

110081239.text: Because, as it happens, I'm currently trying to acquire some Smaragdus Jadeite myself. I noticed strong traces of Geo energy around Mr. Krosl, so perhaps he has, in fact, secured some.

110081240.text: Whether he actually made it into an item of jewelry or not is a separate matter... But either way, it's a lead. As long as we follow it... who knows? We might just be able to get our hands on some Smaragdus Jadeite.

110081241.text: Also... The idea of someone abusing the law to their advantage... I won't stand for it.

110081242.text: But again, let's not dwell on this. Let's go to, hmm... Where can we find someone who processes ore...

110081243.text: Ah, I've got it. Let's pay a visit to <color=#00E1FFFF>Shitou</color>, the boss of The Jade Mystery. He's a professional when it comes to working with stone and ore.

110081244.text: If Mr. Krosl had his ore worked on at all, Shitou would undoubtedly have been his first choice.

110080601.text: Why, hello there, honored customers. Welcome to— Oh, it's you, Miss Yanfei. Is... something the matter?

110080602.text: S—Surely not more spurious claims that my jade betting is rigged and no one can ever win? Oh, I swear on all that is sacred...

110080603.text: No, nothing of the sort. Has a Snezhnayan merchant named Krosl enlisted your ore processing services recently, by any chance?

110080604.text: A Snezhnayan merchant named Krosl, you say...

110080605.text: Mm, I do remember that. He brought me a piece of ore, claiming that it was Smaragdus Jadeite.

110080606.text: That was the first time I'd ever encountered it, so I had no way of telling if it was really Smaragdus Jadeite or not. But if a customer insists, far be it from me to contradict them...

110080607.text: He was quite generous with his money, too, so I didn't give it too much thought. I processed the ore as per his request.

110080608.text: Hmm... Do you have any leftover debris from your work on it?

110080609.text: Why, yes — it was my first time encountering this ore, after all, so I kept a few loose shavings to study myself later. They're <color=#00E1FFFF>right over there</color>, in fact.

110080610.text: Thank you, Sir. We'll take a look at them.

110081501.text: Huh? If my eyes don't deceive me, the cross-sections and patterning suggest that these are <color=#00E1FFFF>Smaragdus Nephrite</color> shavings.

110081503.text: Yes. It's not particularly rare, nor is it especially valuable. It's used to make jewelry all the time.

110081504.text: I've heard it said that Smaragdus Nephrite is in fact the outer layer of Smaragdus Jadeite, though no one's ever proven it.

110081505.text: A thin layer of separation, huh.

110081506.text: If you must see for yourself, try examining these shavings for traces of elemental energy. Smaragdus Nephrite is an entirely ordinary ore containing no elemental energy whatsoever.

110081507.text: Is that so... Well, we might as well give Elemental Sight a shot.

110081509.text: Not a trace of elemental energy.

110081510.text: So they really are different! But wait, how come Zhiqiao was able to tell what it was just by looking at the shards? That's pretty awesome.

110081511.text: There's nothing special to it. It just so happens that I've come across a great many of these in my time.

110081512.text: Why couldn't Shitou tell them apart?

110081513.text: These two stones actually look very similar. Someone without a deep understanding of them would find it very difficult to tell them apart.

110081514.text: There may be only a subtle difference for the casual viewer, but that translates to an astronomical difference in terms of the market price.

110081515.text: And, I'm sure, a significant difference in the cost of having them carved into shape...

110081516.text: Alright, let's focus up. We're going off on a tangent.

110081517.text: But... Never mind Shitou — why would Mr. Krosl... huh...

110081518.text: Unusual actions have unusual reasons behind them. Let's take some of these shavings back to Shitou.

110081401.text: Miss Yanfei... Might I be so bold as to inquire... um...

110081402.text: If you could just confirm for me once more, Sir: Mr. Krosl did indeed claim that the ore he brought to your store was in fact "Smaragdus Jadeite," did he not?

110081403.text: Uh... yes, that's right. I still have a record of the job with me, in fact, um... Here, it says quite clearly: "One chunk Smaragdus Jadeite, uncut."

110081404.text: Then I have no further questions. But could I borrow the processing record and these stone shavings?

110081405.text: Of course... But might I ask why you need them?

110081406.text: Oh, I have my reasons... Ah, yes, please sign here on this <color=#00E1FFFF>affidavit</color>.

110081407.text: This document shall serve as signed proof that these stone shavings originated from the, ah, ore that Mr. Krosl brought to your store. Please read it carefully.

110081408.text: Hmm, yes... I see, I see. Forgive me for asking again, Miss Yanfei, but... might I know the nature of the incident on this occasion?

110081409.text: I wouldn't say there's been an "incident" — just a minor issue. Thank you, Sir. I'll take these with me.

110081410.text: With this hard evidence to back us up, Krosl won't dare try to deny what he did!

110081411.text: On the contrary, this is far from sufficient to build a case. We need to find something a little more... "compelling."

110081412.text: If you want to make jewelry, you need a professional jewelsmith. Let me think...

110081414.text: Aha, got it. <color=#00E1FFFF>Xingxi</color>. She often helps link people up with a jewelsmith. Let's go pay her a visit.

110081415.text: Well, that was quick... How come you know so many people?

110081416.text: Because lots of people come to me for legal advice every day.

110081417.text: As you know, Liyue Harbor is the City of Contracts, and contracts... well, I should say, "laws," are very important to us.

110081418.text: But the amendments made by the Tianquan to our laws are unnecessarily complicated. How can I put this? It just seems like they're hard to understand and impossible to finish.

110081419.text: As such, legal advisers like myself provide quite the popular service indeed.

110081420.text: So you help them make sense of the law? But didn't you say that it's "hard to understand and impossible to finish"?

110081421.text: Yes, well... That's no obstacle, because I've memorized all the legal codices.

110081423.text: You sound surprised. Knowing the law inside out is a legal adviser's bread and butter, you know.

110081424.text: Is this how adepti become so adept at everything...

110081425.text: Oh, this has nothing to do with being an adeptus — I just like reading things.

110081427.text: Well, that's that, then. Let's go look for Xingxi.

110080701.text: Oh, Miss Yanfei, it's you. ...Has something happened? Did the client from last time...

110080702.text: Have no further trouble from then on? Yes, of course. I'm just here to ask you a few questions.

110080703.text: Has a merchant by the name of Krosl asked you to put him in contact with a jewelsmith recently?

110080704.text: Krosl... Yes, I remember him, he's a merchant from Snezhnaya, no? Yes, he came to me with a chunk of something he called "Smaragdus Jadeite."

110080705.text: The design of the hairpins that he gave me was quite intricate, so it took me some work to find someone who was up to the job. Eventually, I found an older jewelsmith who made them exactly according to his specifications.

110080706.text: This order was on hold for a very long time and only completed quite recently, which is why I remember it so well.

110080707.text: Doesn't seem like there's any evidence to be found here...

110080708.text: Ms. Xingxi, I'd like for you to confirm for me once more: When Mr. Krosl commissioned you to find him a jewelsmith, did he or did he not assert that the material he presented to you that day was called "Smaragdus Jadeite"?

110080709.text: Yes, I'm sure of it. The hairpins were made using many expensive materials and the asking price was quite high, so we had to put this transaction on record with the Ministry of Civil Affairs.

110080710.text: Mr. Krosl wasn't very familiar with the necessary procedures, so I filed it on his behalf.

110080711.text: Oh, I also kept <color=#00E1FFFF>a copy for my own records</color>. See for yourself: the item is called "Smaragdus Jadeite Twin-Phoenix Pins."

110080712.text: The inlaid gemstone is recorded as Smaragdus Jadeite. The document even has the official seal of the Ministry on it.

110080713.text: Thank you, Xingxi. Now, could you let me borrow this document?

110080714.text: Sure, it isn't serving much purpose here, anyway. I take it, then, that... there's been some more trouble?

110080715.text: Nothing you need to worry about, just a minor issue. I'll return your document as soon as I'm done with it. Thanks again!

110080716.text: Why is everyone's first reaction always to assume someone or something is in trouble?

110080717.text: Must be the nature of legal consultancy.

110080718.text: Hmm... I believe we have almost all the evidence we need. We just need to make one last trip — let's go to Bubu Pharmacy to speak with <color=#00E1FFFF>Dr. Baizhu</color>.

110080720.text: The weirdo with the snake around his neck? What do you wanna speak to him for?

110080721.text: Because only he can provide an authoritative statement confirming that Smaragdus Jadeite is harmful to the human body.

110080722.text: Once we have this final piece of evidence in our hands, we can wrap this case up.

110080901.text: My, my, to what do I owe the pleasure? Though I'm afraid that if you're looking for our little Qiqi, she's out gathering herbs.

110080902.text: And if it isn't Miss Yanfei as well. Now that's an even rarer honor. What business brings you here, might I inquire? Some charlatans peddling ineffectual medicines again, no doubt?

110080903.text: No, no, I'm here this time to ask if you're familiar with Smaragdus Jadeite.

110080904.text: Smaragdus Jadeite? Why, yes, there is some information about it included in the Sixth Commentary on the "Seven Mountain Treatises."

110080905.text: The "Seven Mountain Treatises" states that this substance springs forth from Stonemarrow within the mountains, and will bring disaster to any mere mortals who touch it.

110080906.text: It is abundant in elemental energy, so if someone without a Vision is in contact with it for a prolonged period... Best case scenario, they fall ill, worst-case scenario, they'll suffer great changes in personality and their illness will only ever get worse...

110080907.text: Heh... Anyway, I'm sure you didn't come all this way just to chit-chat. Knowing you, Yanfei, and given the specific nature of your question...

110080908.text: I suppose that you're about to ask me to write an official affidavit attesting to the pharmaceutical peculiarities of Smaragdus Jadeite?

110080909.text: That is indeed the case... If you would be so kind, Dr. Baizhu.

110080910.text: No trouble at all, it's just a single document. Won't take me a moment. I would mention, though, that you're not the only one who's developed a curiosity for Smaragdus Jadeite recently. A Snezhnayan merchant came to ask me about it not long ago.

110080911.text: But after I gave him my reply, his expression shifted to one of remarkable disappointment...

110080912.text: I wonder, Ms. Yanfei, if your pressing business might be related to this Snezhnayan merchant?

110080913.text: Ah, you needn't concern yourself about that, Dr. Baizhu. Thank you for penning us that document, I'll make sure to compensate you in due course.

110080914.text: You're too kind. Take care, now.

110080915.text: That Baizhu guy is as weird as ever.

110081001.text: Miss Yanfei, have you finished your investigation? I trust you will now be in a position to assess the compensation due?

110081002.text: Yes, my investigation is indeed concluded. I can now provide a final figure for the amount payable.

110081003.text: Wonderful! Well then, please, could you do the honors, Miss Yanfei.

110081004.text: Of course. According to the stipulations of the contract...

110081005.text: Mr. Krosl, you must pay Ms. Zhiqiao ten times the original transaction price in Mora.

110081006.text: Sure— Wait, what!? M—Me, pay her? Surely there's been some kind of mistake, Miss Yanfei?

110081007.text: Not at all. According to my investigations and the material evidence that we've gathered, the substance claimed to be Smaragdus Jadeite that was inlaid within the Smaragdus Jadeite Twin-Phoenix Pins that you rented out to Ms. Zhiqiao was, in fact, Smaragdus Nephrite.

110081008.text: Now, the contract states very clearly that ten times the price shall be paid should the article not be genuine. Accordingly, you are liable for this sum, which is payable to Ms. Zhiqiao in Mora.

110081009.text: Material evidence? What material evidence? Why, Miss Yanfei, you cannot frame me like this!

110081010.text: ...I spent a huge sum to obtain that Smaragdus Jadeite, and yet you claim that the ore inlaid on the hairpins is somehow fake. I—I demand to see your evidence!

110081011.text: Indeed, only a testimony from an expert witness involved in the processing of the ore can serve as an authoritative assessment of whether it is genuine... Traveler, please produce the evidence in question.

110081015.text: This is a processing record from The Jade Mystery, along with stone samples and an affidavit signed by the business owner, Shitou.

110081017.text: Seriously...? Even the boss there couldn't differentiate between Smaragdus Jadeite and Smaragdus Nephrite. How does this prove anything?

110081018.text: In any case, Smaragdus Nephrite is the outer layer of Smaragdus Jadeite... So I had him cut away the Nephrite, he returned the valuable Jadeite core to me, and some Nephrite samples remain in the store. What am I missing, exactly?

110081020.text: Well, your claim that my ore is fake is just as unsubstantiated. And we are here to talk about evidence, aren't we?

110081021.text: Ugh... Looks like our first piece of evidence didn't convince him at all. Seems like he came prepared. What should we do next?

110081022.text: Hard evidence... Something legally binding... We have just the thing. Show him, Traveler.

110081016.text: Ahem... If we want to determine whether the ore is genuine, we need to start with evidence from The Jade Mystery. Clearly, you still have a few things to learn about this aspect of legal proceedings...

110081101.text: Ah, you've returned. How did it go? Were you able to find the Smaragdus Jadeite?

110081103.text: Good, good. Then we have all the materials we need.

110081104.text: Well, if we're all set, Granny, I'll get going now. Got a ton of clients waiting for me back at the office.

110081105.text: Oh, you... alright then, go see to your business. Granny should be able to handle the rest.

110081106.text: I'm off then, bye! Oh yes, Traveler, make sure you don't lose the business card I gave you.

110081107.text: I've been looking into the laws of other nations as well. If you should ever bump into any trouble with the law, come find me directly. Regulars get discounts too!

110081108.text: Come now, child, are you leaving or are you not? If you have no wish to leave, perhaps you'd like to help me clean my teapot, mm?

110081110.text: *sigh* ...That child, goodness knows where she learned to be so rambunctious. Her father was hardly so riotous or fond of talking nonsense back in the day when he stood beside Rex Lapis.

110081112.text: Indeed she is... Liyue has changed, and the adepti must also learn to change.

110081113.text: Yanfei might be overly garrulous, but she is also the most intimately acquainted with the city among us all.

110081114.text: *sigh* Liyue is not the same place I once knew...

110081116.text: Alright then, let us speak of this no more. Back on topic, I believe that I still owe you a little gift.

110081117.text: Ooh! Paimon's so excited! How is it made?

110081118.text: And how long does it take...

110081119.text: Haha, it is but a single teapot. It shan't take long at all. Just wait here for a moment...

110081121.text: Hoo, there we go. This <color=#00E1FFFF>Serenitea Pot</color> is all yours now.

110081122.text: Hold it firmly — if you were to drop it... Ho ho, goodness! Who knows what might happen?

110081123.text: Take these blueprints with you as well. You'll need them if you wish to make your teapot a little more lively inside.

110081125.text: Wait a minute... Granny, how exactly are we supposed to use this teapot?

110081126.text: Oh, you needn't worry about that. I've already arranged for a certain <color=#00E1FFFF>little helper</color> to await you within this teapot. She will explain everything you need to know about it.
